title: Zero-network paired-model capability confirmation preflight
objective: Freeze and audit four fair capability-confirmation requests across two task families and two models before any paid execution.

OfficeQA.contract: Exactly 12 operand objects with only period and value; evidence, operands, result, and answer must agree.

SpreadsheetBench.contract: Exactly 12 compact edits, explanation at most 160 characters, and independent per-column comparison semantics.

decision_gate.pass: Exactly four frozen requests, zero calls, identical task content across models, stricter contracts present, no answer or golden-formula leakage, and all hashes/audits recorded.
decision_gate.live_successor: requires a new immutable config and separate authorization for exactly four calls
